item.title: Version 1.5.1
item.description:
Lumary Audio 1.5.1
A small fix for Monitor.
• When you first turn MONITOR on, macOS asks to let Lumary Audio record system audio. That request now describes Monitor as it is: with MONITOR on, the sound of your other apps runs through your headphone or speaker correction. Nothing is recorded.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
